name: XR Desktop
summary:
YOUR COMPUTER, WITHOUT LIMITS
Stream your Windows PC or Mac to Meta Quest over Wi-Fi with low latency and a sharp picture. Work, browse, code, watch and play on giant screens. No cables.

MULTI-MONITOR WORKSPACE
• Add a left and right screen in one click: virtual monitors are created for you, no extra hardware.
• Move windows between screens like a real desk. Resize, move and curve every screen.

YOUR PRIVATE VR CINEMA
• Watch on a giant 16-meter screen in a full movie theater.
